int_name: N BROAD ST & W ROCKLAND ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and signalized traffic control. While sidewalks and a bus stop are present, the lack of a pedestrian refuge and faded pavement markings increase exposure risk for those crossing the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are worn and faded, which may reduce their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a mid-block refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to ensure it is clearly seen by all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with commercial and residential land use. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of marked crosswalks and significant crossing distances create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this multi-leg intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles (SUV and pickup truck) in the intersection and parked near corners block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial corridor with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and markings are present, the long, unprotected crossing distance across multiple lanes poses a significant risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic plus parking areas without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb line may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to enter the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and paved sidewalks in a mixed-use area. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic lights are present, there is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals and street trees. The wide corner radii and parked vehicles near the intersection may create visibility and speed issues for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which may lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signalized poles on the corners

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner near the laundromat has a wide radius, which can encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner near the laundromat

hazards.name: Parked vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the side street may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the side street

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add countdown pedestrian signal heads to provide clear timing information for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalks to improve visibility for all road users.
